16.5 Acquisition of York Arcade Holdings PLC
Lankem Ceylon PLC (LCPLC) made an offer to its parent company, The Colombo Fort Land & Building PLC (CFLB) to purchase
CFLB’s Equity stake of 49.27% in York Arcade Holdings PLC (YAH) represented by 369,495 Ordinary Voting Shares. The Board
of CFLB advised the Company that they have agreed to accept the offer and the said transaction was executed on 24th
November 2025, on the Trading Floor of the Colombo Stock Exchange. The said number of shares were acquired at Rs. 921.75
per share.
Further to the Company’s acquisition of a 49.27% equity stake in York Arcade Holdings PLC (YAH) represented by 369,495
Ordinary Voting Shares from parent Company, The Colombo Fort Land & Building PLC, the Company has also acquired
on 24th November 2025, a further equity stake of 0.88% of YAH, from related entities, Fort Investments PLC and Colombo
Investment Trust PLC amounting 1,525 and 5,043 Ordinary Colombo Shares respectively at a price of Rs.882.75 per share
Pursuant to the aforesaid transactions where the Company has acquired in total 50.15% of YAH shares, the said YAH becomes
a subsidiary of Lankem Ceylon PLC, and the ultimate parent company of YAH remains The Colombo Fort Land & Building PLC.
Subsequently the Company disposed 10% of its equity stake, representing 15,000,000 shares of the issued Ordinary Shares of
York Arcade Holdings PLC to Darley Butler & Co. Ltd on the trading floor of the Colombo Stock Exchange. However, acting in
concert with Darley Butler & Co.Ltd, the holding in York Arcade Holdings PLC stands at 50.15%.
